outcomes.rule_text: alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET SCAN Potential Port Scan Detected"; flow:stateless; detection_filter:track by_src, count 60, seconds 300; classtype:network-scan; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 2222 (msg: "ET SCAN SSH Brute Force Attempt"; flow: to_server, established; detection_filter: track by_src, count 10, seconds 300; classtype: attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET WEB_SPECIFIC_APPS Gobuster Directory Brute Force Attempt"; flow:established,to_server; http.user_agent; content:"gobuster/3.8.2"; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 30, seconds 300; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert udp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 53 (msg:"ET DOS Potential DNS Query Flood from Single Source"; dns.query; content:".flood-test.example"; nocase; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 100, seconds 60; classtype:denial-of-service; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET SCAN Potential Port Scan Detected"; flow:to_server; detection_filter:track by_src, count 60, seconds 300; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 2222 (msg:"ET SCAN Potential SSH Brute Force Attempt"; flow:to_server,established; detection_filter:track by_src,count 10,seconds 300; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET WEB-ATTACK Gobuster Directory Brute Force User-Agent"; http.user_agent; content:"gobuster"; nocase; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 5, seconds 60; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert udp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 53 (msg:"ET DOS Potential DNS Query Flood from Single Source"; dns.query; content:".flood-test.example"; nocase; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 100, seconds 60; classtype:denial-of-service; sid:1000000; rev:1;)
